name: Haryana Capfin Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1998, Haryana Capfin Ltd is in the business of Investment in shares and securities and financing[1]
keyPoints:
Registration:[1][2]
Company is a Non Systemically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Company, though the related NBFC activities have not been started. It has invested in the shares of Maharashtra Seamless Limited which is the group's flagship company

pros: Stock is trading at 0.30 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.17% over last 3 years.
